title: 면접 자기소개: -거니와로 강점 두 가지 말하기
objective: Introduce your major and experience, and give two strengths with -거니와.
summary: Name two strengths in an interview with -거니와.
setting: A meeting room at a company. An interviewer is talking with Li Wei, who has applied for a job on the marketing team.

task.title: Practice interview answers
task.line: Use the words and the -거니와 pattern from page 1 to complete each interview answer.

words.meaning: and also, not only... but also (adds a second point to the first one; formal, good for interviews)
words.example: 그 사람은 성격이 밝거니와 일도 잘해요.
words.exampleMeaning: That person has a cheerful personality and is good at the job, too.

words.meaning: N, of course, and also… (the first thing is obvious; the second one is extra)
words.example: 이 일은 체력은 물론이거니와 인내심도 필요해요.
words.exampleMeaning: This job needs physical strength, of course, and patience too.

words.meaning: to apply (for a job or position)
words.exampleMeaning: I applied for the overseas sales team this time.
I majored in computer engineering at university.

words.meaning: to take charge of (a task or role)
words.exampleMeaning: I was in charge of the accounts in my club.

words.meaning: to get along with, to mix well with (people)
words.exampleMeaning: I got along with my new coworkers right away.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하십니까. 마케팅팀에 지원한 리웨이입니다. 한국에서 경영학을 전공했고, 1년 동안 무역 회사에서 인턴으로 일했습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'm Li Wei, and I've applied for the marketing team. I majored in business administration in Korea and worked as an intern at a trading company for a year.
What do you think your strengths are?

dialogue.korean: 저는 꼼꼼하거니와 맡은 일은 끝까지 책임지는 편입니다. 인턴 때도 자료 정리를 맡았는데 실수가 거의 없었습니다.
dialogue.meaning: I'm careful with details, and I also see my work through to the end. As an intern, I was in charge of organizing data, and I made almost no mistakes.
How well do you speak foreign languages?

dialogue.korean: 중국어는 물론이거니와 영어로도 업무 메일을 쓸 수 있습니다.
dialogue.meaning: I can write work emails in Chinese, of course, and in English too.

exercises: Fill in the blank with 빠르다 + -거니와: 저는 일 처리가 ____ 정확해서 번역 일을 잘합니다.
Fill in the blank with the expression that means 'N, of course, and also': 이 자리에는 영어는 ____ 일본어 실력도 필요합니다.
Choose the right word for each sentence: ① 대학교 축제 때 저는 무대 준비를 (맡았습니다 / 어울렸습니다). ② 저는 이번에 디자인팀에 (전공했습니다 / 지원했습니다).
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 경험이 / 저는 / 있습니다 / 고객을 상대한
Join the two sentences into one with -거니와. End it with -ㅂ니다: 저는 성실합니다. 시간 약속도 잘 지킵니다.
answers: 저는 성실하거니와 시간 약속도 잘 지킵니다.
